overview: The two alternating phases of every heartbeat — one contracting, one relaxing.
genZNote: Systole: the heart squeezes and pushes. Diastole: the heart chills and refills.

aspects.label: Action of the Heart
aspects.valueA: Contraction phase — the heart chambers squeeze to pump blood out.
aspects.valueB: Relaxation phase — the heart chambers relax and fill with blood.

aspects.label: Effect on Blood Pressure
aspects.valueA: Corresponds to the higher (systolic) blood pressure reading.
aspects.valueB: Corresponds to the lower (diastolic) blood pressure reading.

overlay.examHighYieldNote: A normal blood pressure reading of 120/80 mmHg represents systolic over diastolic pressure.
overlay.commonMisconception: Systole does not refer only to the ventricles — atrial systole and ventricular systole are distinct, sequential events in a single heartbeat.
